# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM backport**

## Highlights

Backports the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM fix and a WinUI Projection DLL fix to 3.119.x.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple library/app TFMs backported** — Brings the 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFM fix from the v4 line back to 3.119.x so Apple consumers on this line get the same target-framework alignment. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 fixed** — Resolves a packaging issue where the WinUI projection DLL could not be found by .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
